overview: Google launched Gemini 4 Argon, and xAI pushed a large Grok Bot update while Elon Musk amplified many user examples. OpenAI disclosed a hidden recording device planted in its office that led to an FBI arrest. SpaceX's first returned Starship is back at Starbase, and Tesla has scheduled a Roadster event for Thursday.

top_items.title: demishassabis - Gemini 4 Argon is rolling out to Google Ultra and Pro subscribers in the Gemini app and Search, and to Ultra in Antigravity
elonmusk - Grok Bot 0.70.2 gives each bot its own email address, adds Figma/Notion/Canva cards and an approval step before irreversible actions
MatthewBerman - OpenAI says an employee hid a recording device in its office; its models helped trace it, and the FBI made an arrest
elonmusk - SpaceX's Ship 40, the first Starship returned to its launch site, now stands in a Starbase Megabay for heatshield and Raptor data
elonmusk - Tesla will stream its Roadster event live this Thursday at 7:55pm CST; Musk's only comment was 'Timing is everything'
tobi - Shopify put its shop CLI in the browser via WebMCP, letting agents search 1B+ products, check out and use single-use payment credentials
brian_armstrong - Base launches Earn & Borrow, a stack for apps to offer stablecoin yield and loans against crypto
